## What changed, and why?

Describe the mathematical question or repository problem you started from and
the useful difference this pull request makes. Plain language is welcome.

## What can another person check?

Name the proof, source, paper passage, calculation, test result, or other
public evidence that supports the change. Say what you actually checked and
what you did not check.

## What remains open or uncertain?

State the surviving boundary. In particular, do not turn a conditional result,
finite computation, formal reduction, or failed search into a solution of an
open problem.

## Credit and provenance

Tell us the name or handle you want credited, identify material collaborators
or prior work, and mention the public commit or release from which you began if
it matters. If this continues an earlier return, link it rather than replacing
its history.

## Maintainer and agent follow-through
